name: leaf
description: Generative UI: the agent builds the page the task needs, writes new widgets when the project calls for them, and answers the user's comments and edits over a messaging and collaboration bus.

interface.longDescription: The agent builds the page the task needs from an open vocabulary of widgets, and writes a new widget when the project calls for one. Comments, drags, and edits come back to the session over a messaging and collaboration bus.
defaultPrompt: Present this work as a Leaf page.
Use Leaf to put this plan on a page.
